title: Mixed Event — Scramble Fan Festival! — Episode5 Our First Practice Together

meta.Event Outline: Minori, Ichika, Kohane and Nene are all set to sing in the annual VIRTUAL SINGER Fan Festival. Kanade and the rest of N25 also attend, keen to witness their favorite creators. The curtains rise, uniting heartfelt emotions into a grand symphony!

rows.Line: A few days later
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm Kohane's friend, Minori Hanasato! I've really been looking forward to meeting all of you today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Nene
rows.Line: Thank you for having us!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're more than welcome! Kohane told me all about you guys, so I've been looking forward to this day too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's give today's practice everything we've got!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: FYI, I'm not teaching you guys anything. We're just gonna have practice today like normal.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: U-Understood...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, it's the split-personality guy. But I guess we don't get Mr. Nice Guy today...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are you looking at...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-Nothing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, don't be so mean to them...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
Shinonome looks scary, but he's really a nice guy underneath.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, what are you running your mouth off like that for?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: B-But...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree with Azusawa. Akito says these things, but is really a nice person deep down.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So there's no need for any of you to feel scared.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Still, this is quite a surprise.
I didn't realize that you'd be bringing Hoshino here today, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, we met when I was doing a street performance. After that, we started having lunch and even practicing singing together.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, you two already know each other?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, she's friends with Tsukasa's younger sister and is even in a band with her now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, him...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's like we already all know each other!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: By complete coincidence.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But is it true that you're an idol, Minori? What kind of stuff do you usually do?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, I am! I'm in a group called MORE MORE JUMP! and we're currently focused on making videos and doing livestreams online!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We even got to help put on an event at an elementary school the other day. We played with all the students and put on a show for them!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds really fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, MORE MORE JUMP!
As in Haruka Kiritani's group...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, that's right...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I knew it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You know Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I've known her forever. We've been friends, and rivals, for as long as I can remember.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?!
Does that mean you've known her since she was little?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm so jealous...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. It's no big deal, really.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But now I see...
You're the one she keeps talking about...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, nevermind!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, I can tell you more about Haruka when she was little later.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
When Haruka was little?!
Yes, please, absolutely!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, let's get started already.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
You guys good to go?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yes...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll try my best!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: First, we'll have you watch us to get a sense of what our performances are like. After that, we're hoping that you'll be able to jump in with us for a few parts. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, understood.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Yeah!
song00005_off_s

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh wow... I'm getting goosebumps just listening to them sing...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She was really good when we went to the Seaside School, but Kohane's such an amazing singer...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(No, it's not just her.
They're all amazing...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, so that's about our usual.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-That was incredible...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I thought so too...!
It felt so powerful.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. Thanks.
But some parts of it are still bugging me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
How?!
You guys sounded amazing just now...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We can't be happy with just this.
There's still room for improvement.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shiraishi, you have a habit of rushing into the chorus, which is causing Azusawa to fall out of rhythm.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sorry, my bad!
I promise to be more careful!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And it's good that you helped Azusawa out back there, but it also caused you to fall behind during the next part. Just keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yup. Got it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're doing great for the most part, Toya, but your voice is sort of getting drowned out during the parts where we all sing together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I've been noticing that too.
I'll make sure to work on my volume more.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You guys really don't mince words with each other, huh? We never talk like this in my troupe.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This feels like such a new experience!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, wanna try singing all together now? No, wait, making you guys sing a song you don't know wouldn't exactly be fair...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then why don't you try singing the song you'll be performing for the Fan Festival?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, right!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I'll start us off.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, we can't hear you.
You'll never reach the people in the back if you're this quiet.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You don't have to hold back here!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Okay! Like this...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, there you go! Much better!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Shinonome is honestly a little scary, but he listens so closely and is willing to say what needs to be said.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (He reminds me of Shiho in a way...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh wow, your singing voice is beautiful...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Your pitch and tone are excellent too. If you raise your volume just a little bit more, I believe you'll have no trouble reaching everyone in the back.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That just leaves you, Hanasato...
song00002_off_sabi

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Stop.
You were late there just now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That sort of mistake is gonna cause a domino effect that ripples across the whole song. You have to stop it during the next part.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You were slightly out of rhythm as well. Try to stay calm and listen for what the others are doing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I like how your voice is full of so much energy! If you can learn to sing from your gut instead of your throat, it'll probably sound much better!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (This is incredible. They're giving me such good advice after singing for just a little bit. This is what Kohane's been doing all this time...?!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(But I want to get better...!
I can't let their advice go to waste!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Minori, how do you feel?
If it feels like too much, you can tell us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks, but I think I can do it!
Let me try that one more time!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, how about we call it a day?
Great work today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I learned so much!
It feels like I'm already a better singer after today!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're kidding, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I understand how you feel, Minori. We were all able to see and hear things that we normally wouldn't have been able to.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah. Thanks, you guys...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm glad we could help.
We'll be looking forward to the Fan Festival.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, we promise to be there to support you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hang on, does that include me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Well, duh...
Did you forget that Kohane's gonna be performing?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So good luck, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!
